description: This chart illustrates the accuracy of several large language models across different reasoning approaches. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled “Davinci-003”, “ChatGPT”, “BARD”, “Abductive”, “Deductive”, and “Mix”, arranged in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each category on the horizontal axis has three bars representing the accuracy for "Inductive", "Abductive", and "Mix" reasoning. The bars are represented with a gradient of color, transitioning from blue at the base to green and yellow towards the top, indicating increasing accuracy values. The shortest bar, representing “ChatGPT” with “Inductive” reasoning, has an approximate height of 0.2. The tallest bars, representing “Mix” reasoning for all three models, reach approximately 0.7 to 0.8.  The bars are grouped, with each group corresponding to a specific language model, and bars within each group are arranged side-by-side representing the reasoning approach; no bars are visibly emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
